# Lumient

> AI for lender reporting and credit monitoring

Lumient reads your agreements, amendments, and loan tape, tracks every rule and number, and flags what needs attention, with the source behind each one.

## Report to your funders

For specialty lenders and CDFIs reporting to their warehouse lenders and funders.

- [Report to your funders](https://hellolumient.com/#report): Borrowing base certificates, servicing reports and compliance certificates, drafted in each lender's own format. Every number links back to its source, and your team reviews and approves each one.
- [See every loan and why it's ineligible](https://hellolumient.com/#step-ineligible): Every ineligible loan explained, with the exact rule each one fails.

## Monitor your borrowers

For venture and growth lenders, warehouse and lender finance, and private credit.

- [Monitor your borrowers](https://hellolumient.com/#monitor): Keep track of every loan in your portfolio with less spreadsheet work. Know who is close to a covenant breach and which reports are late.
- [Walk into committee with the review done](https://hellolumient.com/#step-review): A dashboard and credit committee report built from the packages your borrowers send.

## For every team

- [Ask across every agreement](https://hellolumient.com/#step-agreements)
- [Alerts before deadlines](https://hellolumient.com/#step-deadlines)
- [Works with the AI you already use](https://hellolumient.com/#step-copilot): Feeds approved numbers to Abacus and Power BI.

## Connects to

- [Connects to](https://hellolumient.com/#connects-title): SharePoint, Outlook, Excel, Teams, Snowflake, Power BI, Salesforce, nCino, NetSuite, Box, Alteryx.
